- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided the online cancellation steps for Entertainment Weekly:
  1. Go to [www.ew.com/service](http://www.ew.com/service)
  2. Click on "Manage My Account"
  3. Log in to the account using email and password
  4. Click on "Cancel Subscription" and follow the prompts
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided the phone cancellation details for Entertainment Weekly:
  1. Call 1-800-828-6882 (Monday-Friday, 8am-9pm ET)
  2. Have account number or subscription address ready
  3. Inform the representative about the cancellation
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided email cancellation details for Entertainment Weekly:
  1. Email [ewcustserv@cdsfulfillment.com](mailto:ewcustserv@cdsfulfillment.com)
  2. Include name, address, and account number (if available)
  3. State the desire to cancel the subscription
